shots.words: Every Saturday, Otto buys one birthday candle.
shots.draw: Bakery counter, over Otto's shoulder: one striped birthday candle held up big in the foreground, Mae the baker behind the counter, a cake stand and a sign 'CANDLES 40c'
shots.moves: snap zoom on frame 0, slow push

shots.draw: Insert, top-down: the empty counter, one candle laid on it, a coin
shots.moves: the candle rolls a little and stops

shots.words: The baker has never asked who it's for.
shots.draw: Mae MCU behind the counter, flat face, eyes on the candle then on Otto

shots.words: She just rings it up. Forty cents.
shots.draw: Insert: the old till, its window flips to 0.40; her finger presses a key
Wide of the bakery: Otto at the counter holds up two fingers... (pose point) two candles now on the counter
Mae close, eyes narrowed, the handwritten caption 'Whose birthday?'

shots.words: Otto doesn't explain. He never does.
shots.draw: Otto close, front, deadpan, a two-drawing blink

shots.words: At home, his cactus gets one candle every Saturday.
shots.draw: Otto's windowsill at home: a cactus in a clay pot with one lit birthday candle stuck in the soil

shots.words: This week, a small cactus grew out of the side.
shots.draw: Insert: a tiny cactus pup bulging out of the big one's side
Both cacti, each with a lit candle; Otto's head rises into frame below, watching
Button: Otto at the windowsill, deadpan, both flames flicker; a slow blink
